blocks.text: Osmoregulation ki salahiyat ki buniyad par janwaron ko do groups mein taqseem kiya jata hai: osmoconformers aur osmoregulators.

Osmoconformers woh janwar hain jo apni jism ki rutoobaton ki osmotic concentration (pani mein ghule maddon ki miqdar) ko apne mahol ke barabar rehne dete hain. Yeh apne jism mein pani aur ghule maddon ki miqdar khud qaim nahin rakh sakte. Is liye bahar ka pani badalne se in ke andar ki miqdar bhi badal jati hai, aur yeh hamesha apne mahol ke saath isotonic (barabar gaarhe) rehte hain. Aise janwar aam taur par aisi jagah milte hain jahan namak ki miqdar kafi had tak ek jaisi rehti hai, jaise samundar. Misalen: tamam samundari invertebrates (be-reerh janwar), kuch meethe pani ke invertebrates, aur kuch samundari vertebrates (reerh wale janwar) jaise hagfishes, sharks aur rays.

Jo janwar apni jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur ghule maddon ki miqdar khud qaboo kar sakte hain, woh osmoregulators hain. Bahar ka mahol badalta rahe tab bhi yeh andar ki miqdar ek jaisi (constant) rakhte hain. Is ke liye yeh kai tareeqe istemal karte hain, maslan namak ki active transport (tawanai laga kar namak ko andar ya bahar le jana), namak jama karna aur pani bachana. Pani aur khushki (aquatic aur terrestrial) ke zyada tar vertebrates osmoregulators hain.

blocks.prompt: Osmoregulators aur osmoconformers ki tareef ek ek misal ke saath kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers jism ki rutoobaton ko mahol ke mutabiq rehne dete (samundari invertebrate jaise starfish, ya hagfish); osmoregulators mahol kuch bhi ho rutoobatein mustaqil rakhte (meethe pani ki machhli ya insaan).

items: Osmoconformers: andar ki concentration mahol ke barabar (isotonic); samundari invertebrates, hagfishes, sharks, rays.
Osmoregulators: mahol badle tab bhi andar ki concentration khud qaim rakhte hain; zyada tar vertebrates.
